sections.heading: What Goes Under PVC Roofing on Bloomfield Properties?

runs.v: From the deck up: the structural deck of steel, concrete, or wood; a vapor retarder where interior humidity calls for one; rigid insulation such as polyiso, tapered where the roof needs slope; a cover board; and, over an old asphalt roof, a separation layer, because PVC must never touch asphalt. The membrane is then mechanically fastened or fully adhered, and hot-air welds provide fast, adhesive-free seams whose integrity a probe test confirms. A Newark Quality Roofing crew lead will assess the deck and recommend the assembly before the crew can install the membrane on any of the Bloomfield properties it roofs.

Proper gutter systems are essential for Bloomfield's climate: gutters, in seamless aluminum or copper, carry rainwater away from the foundation, improving drainage and preventing water intrusion in basements.

sections.heading: PVC Roof Repair Services, Emergency Roofing Services, or a New Roof?

c.v: What is the 25% rule for roofing?

runs.v: As a rule of thumb, once damage covers about 25% of a roof, a new roof usually costs less over time than repeated repairs, and as a permit rule, N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7 requires a construction permit when more than 25% of a commercial, multi-family, or attached building's roof is repaired or replaced within 12 months. PVC repair services are simple while the sheet is sound: the crew cleans the membrane and hot-air welds a new PVC patch over the damaged area, and timely roof repairs can extend the life of a roof significantly, while widespread wear, stiffened sheet, or wet insulation means it is time to replace the roof.

faqs.q: Why does a Bloomfield restaurant or food-processing roof need PVC instead of TPO or EPDM?

runs.v: Because PVC resists the grease, animal fats, and oils in rooftop kitchen exhaust that soften EPDM and TPO, per the NRCA technical library; where no chemical exposure exists, Newark Quality Roofing specifies TPO or EPDM.

faqs.q: How long does a PVC roof last on a Bloomfield commercial building?

runs.v: About 20 to 30 years, per the Single Ply Roofing Industry and GAF EverGuard warranty terms, with plasticizer loss the main long-term concern, per the NRCA technical library.

faqs.q: Does a commercial PVC roof in Bloomfield require a permit?

runs.v: Yes for a commercial, multi-family, or attached building that replaces the roof or repairs more than 25% of it in 12 months, under N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7; confirm it with the Township of Bloomfield construction office. A detached one- or two-family reroof counts as ordinary maintenance and needs no permit.

faqs.q: Can PVC be installed over my existing modified bitumen roof in Bloomfield?

runs.v: Not directly: PVC degrades on contact with asphalt, per the NRCA technical library, so the crew adds a separation layer or strips to the deck.

faqs.q: Does a PVC roof on a Bloomfield historic-list parcel need extra approval?

runs.v: It can. Confirm with the Township of Bloomfield construction office before work, because properties in a historic district can need extra review; per the National Park Service, National Register listing alone places no federal restriction on a private property owner.
